args.summary: The nightshift-throttles alarm fired because Lambda functions experienced throttling when invocations surged (reaching up to 446 invocations per minute). This was caused by strict reserved concurrency limits (e.g., reserved concurrency of 5 for orders) being hit during traffic spikes.
args.hypotheses:

args.proposed_actions: Consider increasing reserved concurrency limits or adjusting scaling for functions experiencing throttling under higher traffic.
